title: Garfield Totem
description: Now you can have Garfield as your Totem!
body:
# 🐱 Garfield Totem of Undying

Turn your **Totem of Undying** into **Garfield**! Whether you're surviving a dangerous fight or just want a funny companion, Garfield is always there to save the day.

## ✨ Features

- 🐱 Replaces the Totem of Undying with Garfield
- 🎨 32x32 resolution
- 🎮 Works with Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x
- 📦 Lightweight resource pack

## 📥 Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Move the `.zip` file into your `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**.
4. Enjoy your new Garfield Totem!
